name: industry-ai-workflows
description: Claude Code plugins for industry production workflows — Unity asset management, CAD preparation and cloud pipeline automation.

plugins.name: uam-mcp
plugins.description: Publish, version and organize assets in Unity Asset Manager — assets and versions, file upload and download, metadata, references, collections and projects.

plugins.name: uat-mcp
plugins.description: Prepare and optimise CAD data locally with the Unity Asset Transformer (pxz) SDK — import, repair, tessellate, decimate, bake, render and export. Requires a Pixyz license seat.

plugins.name: upa-mcp
plugins.description: Author, trigger and monitor Unity Pipeline Automation pipelines — pipeline JSON and versions, jobs, step approval, logs and app/action discovery.
